content: 1. Nelfinavir affects the metabolism of hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4, potentially increasing the toxicity of co-administered drugs. Therapy modification or close monitoring is recommended. Alternatives should be considered if available, and benzodiazepine doses may need to be reduced. 2. Nelfinavir decreases the level or effect of clopidogrel by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism, reducing clopidogrel bioactivation. Caution and monitoring are advised. 3. Nelfinavir increases the levels of clorazepate by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification or close monitoring is recommended. Alternatives should be considered, and benzodiazepine doses may need to be reduced. 4. Clotrimazole decreases the level or effect of nelfinavir by acting on the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Caution and monitoring are advised. 5. Nelfinavir increases the level or effect of clozapine by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. 6. Nelfinavir increases the level or effect of topical cocaine by affecting CYP2B6 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. 7. Conivaptan increases the level or effect of nelfinavir by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. 8. Nelfinavir increases the level or effect of conjugated estrogens (oral and vaginal) by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. 9. Nelfinavir increases the level or effect of cortisone by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. 10. Nelfinavir increases the levels of crizotinib by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Crizotinib also increases nelfinavir levels via the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. 11. Crofelemer increases nelfinavir levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Crofelemer inhibits CYP3A4 in the gut but is unlikely to inhibit it systemically due to minimal absorption. 12. Nelfinavir increases the level or effect of cyclophosphamide by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. 13. Cyclosporine increases the level or effect of nelfinavir by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism and the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Caution and monitoring are advised. 14. Nelfinavir increases the level or effect of dabigatran by acting on the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Caution and monitoring are advised. Dabigatran should not be co-administered with P-gp inhibitors if CrCl <30 mL/min for atrial fibrillation or <50 mL/min for DVT/PE treatment. 15. Dabrafenib decreases the level or effect of nelfinavir by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification or close monitoring is recommended. 16. Danicopan increases the level or effect of nelfinavir by acting on the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Caution and monitoring are advised. Danicopan increases plasma concentrations of P-gp substrates, and dose reduction of these substrates should be considered where minimal concentration changes may lead to serious adverse reactions. 17. Darifenacin increases the level or effect of nelfinavir by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Nelfinavir also increases the level or effect of darifenacin by the same mechanism. Caution and monitoring are advised. 18. Nelfinavir increases the level or effect of darolutamide by mechanisms involving P-gp and CYP3A4. Therapy modification or close monitoring is recommended. Darolutamide is a substrate of both P-gp and CYP3A4. Dose adjustments may be necessary when co-administered with strong or moderate inhibitors of these pathways. 19. Darunavir increases the level or effect of nelfinavir by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Nelfinavir also increases the level or effect of darunavir by the same mechanism. Both drugs increase the risk of immune reconstitution syndrome. Caution and monitoring are advised. 20. Dasatinib increases the level or effect of nelfinavir by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Nelfinavir also increases the level or effect of dasatinib by the same mechanism. Caution and monitoring are advised. 21. Deferasirox decreases the level or effect of nelfinavir by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. 22. Nelfinavir increases the level or effect of deflazacort by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification or close monitoring is recommended. The deflazacort dose should be reduced to one-third of the recommended dose if co-administered with moderate or strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. 23. Nelfinavir increases the level or effect of desipramine by affecting CYP2D6 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. 24. Nelfinavir increases the levels of desvenlafaxine by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised due to the potential for increased toxicity. 25. Nelfinavir increases the level or effect of dexamethasone by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. 26. DHEA (herbal) increases the level or effect of nelfinavir by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. 27. Nelfinavir increases the levels of diazepam by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification or close monitoring is recommended. Alternatives should be considered if available. 28. Nelfinavir increases the level or effect of diazepam (buccal and intranasal) by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Strong or moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors may decrease the rate of diazepam elimination, increasing adverse reactions. 29. Nelfinavir increases the effects of diazoxide by mechanisms involving insulin resistance. Caution and monitoring are advised due to reports of hyperglycemia with protease inhibitors. 30. Nelfinavir and dichlorphenamide both increase the risk of metabolic acidosis through pharmacodynamic synergy. Therapy modification or close monitoring is recommended. 31. Nelfinavir increases the level or effect of dienogest/estradiol valerate by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Significant changes in plasma levels of estrogen and progestin have been observed with HIV protease inhibitors. Monitor for adverse effects such as nausea, irregular uterine bleeding, breast tenderness, and headache. 32. Diltiazem increases the level or effect of nelfinavir by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Nelfinavir also increases the level or effect of diltiazem by the same mechanism. Caution and monitoring are advised. 33. Nelfinavir increases the levels of dofetilide by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification or close monitoring is recommended. Alternatives should be considered due to the increased risk of QT prolongation and cardiac arrhythmias. 34. Nelfinavir increases the level or effect of doravirine by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Co-administration with CYP3A4 inhibitors may increase plasma concentrations and toxicities of doravirine. 35. Nelfinavir increases the level or effect of doxepin cream by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. 36. Nelfinavir increases the level or effect of doxorubicin (including liposomal formulations) by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. 37. Nelfinavir increases the level or effect of dronabinol by affecting CYP2E1 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Dronabinol is a CYP3A4 substrate. 38. Dronedarone increases the level or effect of nelfinavir by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism and the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Caution and monitoring are advised. The combination of nelfinavir and dronedarone should generally be avoided. 39. Nelfinavir increases the level or effect of duvelisib by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification or close monitoring is recommended. Co-administration with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors increases duvelisib AUC, which may increase the risk of toxicities. Reduce the duvelisib dose to 15 mg BID when co-administered with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. 40. Efavirenz decreases the level or effect of nelfinavir by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Both drugs increase the risk of immune reconstitution syndrome. Caution and monitoring are advised. 41. Elagolix increases the level or effect of nelfinavir by affecting CYP2C19 metabolism and the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Nelfinavir also increases the level or effect of elagolix by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification or close monitoring is recommended. Elagolix 200 mg BID with strong CYP3A inhibitors for >1 month is not recommended. 42. Nelfinavir increases the level or effect of eletriptan by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. 43. Eliglustat increases the levels of nelfinavir by acting on the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Therapy modification or close monitoring is recommended. Therapeutic drug concentrations should be monitored, or the dosage of the P-gp substrate should be reduced and titrated to clinical effect. 44. Nelfinavir increases the levels of elvitegravir by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Elvitegravir is a CYP3A4 substrate, and co-administration with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors may increase its levels. 45. Both nelfinavir and emtricitabine increase the risk of immune reconstitution syndrome. Caution and monitoring are advised. 46. Encorafenib affects CYP3A4 metabolism, both inhibiting and inducing it at clinically relevant plasma concentrations. Caution and monitoring are advised. Co-administration with sensitive CYP3A4 substrates may result in increased toxicity or decreased efficacy of these agents. 47. Nelfinavir increases the level or effect of enfortumab vedotin by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Enfortumab vedotin releases monomethyl auristatin E (MMAE) via proteolytic cleavage, and MMAE is primarily metabolized by CYP3A4. Co-administration with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors may increase free MMAE exposure, leading to increased toxicity. 48. Both nelfinavir and enfuvirtide increase the risk of immune reconstitution syndrome. Caution and monitoring are advised. 49. Nelfinavir increases the level or effect of erlotinib by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. 50. Erythromycin (base, ethylsuccinate, lactobionate, and stearate) increases the level or effect of nelfinavir by acting on the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Caution and monitoring are advised. 51. Nelfinavir increases the levels of escitalopram by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised due to the potential for increased toxicity and the risk of serotonin syndrome. 52. Eslicarbazepine acetate decreases the level or effect of nelfinavir by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism but increases its level or effect by affecting CYP2C19 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. 53. Nelfinavir increases the level or effect of estradiol (oral and vaginal) by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Co-administration with CYP3A4 inhibitors may increase plasma concentrations of estrogens and associated toxicities. 54. Nelfinavir increases the level or effect of conjugated synthetic estrogens, esterified estrogens, and estropipate by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. 55. Nelfinavir increases the levels of eszopiclone by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification or close monitoring is recommended. Reduce the eszopiclone starting dose to 1 mg/day. 56. Nelfinavir increases the levels of ethosuximide by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised due to the potential for increased toxicity. 57. Nelfinavir increases the level or effect of etonogestrel by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. 58. Nelfinavir increases the level or effect of etoposide by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. 59. Nelfinavir increases the level or effect of etravirine by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism, while etravirine decreases the level or effect of nelfinavir by the same mechanism. Caution and monitoring are advised. 60. Nelfinavir decreases the effects of exenatide (injectable solution and suspension) due to insulin resistance. Caution and monitoring are advised.
